Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by strategic capacity expansion into value-added coated steel products such as Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel. Consolidated revenues surpassed the Rs 1,000 Crore milestone for the first time, reaching Rs 1,053.19 Crore with significant improvements in EBITDA, PAT, and capital efficiency metrics. Management outlined aggressive targets, projecting consolidated revenues of Rs 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and Rs 3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29, backed by ongoing capacity additions and a planned cold-rolling mill. The company maintained a conservative, long-term debt-free balance sheet while scaling up its domestic sales footprint and manufacturing platform. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a sales volume growth of 15% to 69641 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The color coating line expansion will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for FY 2024-25 was H11.70 Crore, which was 61.28% lower than the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company reported H11.70 Crore of PAT during FY 2024-25, which was 61.28% lower than previous year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 due to a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, which was noted as the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that a decline in sales growth on both standalone and consolidated levels failed to offset challenges posed by global market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The colour coating line expansion is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
